description: NIE Networks - Assets - Primary Transformers is a dataset listed in NIE Networks Open Data Hub, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Northern Ireland Electricity Networks Limited. Northern Ireland Electricity Networks (NIE) - List of Primary Transformers. Coverage: Northern Ireland (NIE Networks distribution area). The portal files it under NIE Networks Datasets. Its keywords are Asset, Primary, Transformer. The portal shows 417 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-nienetworks-portal.
